old_description: Killian’s Custom Metal Panel and Roofing LLC manufactures custom cut 3’ wide panels and trims.  We have 25 + years of experience in the metal construction Industry.  We are proud of our excellent customer service.  Call us today at
about:
Killian's Custom Metal Roofing & Panel LLC is based in Des Moines, Iowa. The company opened in the fall of 2013, though founder Paula Killian had envisioned the business since the late 1990s. After working at a steel company in Tulsa, Oklahoma, she gained hands-on experience at B&M Metals in Murrayville, Georgia, learning panel fabrication and trim production before launching her own operation.

The shop manufactures custom-cut 3-foot-wide metal panels and matching trim pieces. Its product line includes Tuff Rib panels—29-gauge steel with Sherwin Williams WeatherX paint carrying a 40-year warranty, available in 22 colors or Galvalume—for residential roofs, pole barns, and post-frame agricultural buildings. The company also fabricates standing-seam panels and distributes commercial architectural profiles such as R-Panel, PBR, corrugated rusted panels, and architectural wall and roof systems. In-house capabilities cover fabrication, installation, and distribution, with a typical order turnaround of two to three days.

Killian's serves residential, agricultural, and commercial construction markets. Homeowners and contractors purchase Tuff Rib for houses and pole barns, while commercial projects source architectural panel systems for wall and roof applications. The company also assists customers with repair or replacement matching for existing installations.

Paula Killian started the business to provide the highest level of customer service she had seen emphasized during her training, aiming to sell high-quality materials at the lowest possible price. The firm highlights its 25-plus years of combined industry experience, a staff with deep metal-construction knowledge, and a commitment to timely quotes and responses as its core differentiators.

about:
King Lumber Company operates from Forest, Mississippi, with an additional production facility in Jasper, Texas. The company has been supplying wood products for over 50 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company produces Southern Yellow Pine lumber, including 1-inch boards in various grades (D and Better, #2, #3 GM, #3/#4 HT) and 5/4-inch decking in premium and standard grades. Combined output from its two facilities exceeds 45 million board feet annually. King Lumber also manages logistics through both internal and external trucking fleets to expedite delivery.

Its products serve construction, decking, and building-material markets, though specific customer names are not disclosed. The company serves wholesale and retail buyers seeking Southern Yellow Pine boards and decking, offering custom grade runs upon request.

King Lumber emphasizes honesty, integrity, and quality as its guiding business philosophies. It differentiates itself through quick delivery enabled by its own and contracted fleets, and the ability to accommodate special grade runs.

Kingmaker Foods operates from a facility in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company runs a state-of-the-art food manufacturing plant focused on producing safe, quality fresh food products for customer brands.

about:
Kitchen Local, LLC operates a certified shared-use commercial kitchen in Amesbury, Massachusetts. Founded in 2013, the facility occupies 2,200 square feet within Studios, a historic brick building that once housed Chas. J. Henschel & Co., a carriage and automotive manufacturer. The building sits a few blocks from downtown Amesbury at the intersection of the North Shore and Merrimack Valley regions, just over the New Hampshire border. The company is a member of the Amesbury Chamber of Commerce & Industry.

The kitchen provides around-the-clock access to permitted commercial kitchen work and storage space for food entrepreneurs. It serves chefs, bakers, small-scale food producers, farmers, and cooking and nutrition instructors who use the facility for food production, catering, baking, cooking classes, menu planning, training, recipe testing, photography, and product development. Kitchen Local guides participant businesses through permitting and licensing, connects them with resources, assists with business concept and strategic planning, and helps promote their businesses.

The facility serves culinary professionals and food startups across the North Shore and Merrimack Valley areas. Its participant businesses include food producers, caterers, bakers, and instructors who need affordable, permitted kitchen space without large capital investment. The collaborative environment fosters a community of food entrepreneurs.

Kitchen Local was established to fill a niche for culinary professionals by minimizing risk and start-up costs, allowing food businesses to launch or expand immediately without significant initial capital investment.

old_description: Knox Wire Harnesses has served both the marine industry and our local community. about:
Knox Wire Harnesses was founded in 2019 by Rob Brown in Knoxville, Tennessee. The company began as a local manufacturer focused on delivering high-quality wiring harnesses while building strong community ties.

The shop specializes in custom wire harness assemblies, offering rapid prototyping services and 100% electrical testing on every unit. Its end-to-end quality management system uses revision-controlled quotes, travelers, print-to-manufacture drawings, first articles, PPAPs, board layouts, and QA fixtures to ensure consistency from prototype through production runs.

The company primarily serves the marine industry, leveraging its ABYC Marine Electrical Certification to meet stringent safety and performance standards. It also works with local businesses and residents in the Knoxville area.

Brown's operating philosophy centers on "repaying the trust shown to us tenfold," emphasizing timely vendor payments, employee well-being, and on-time delivery to customers as the foundation for sustainable quality.

name: Kobelco Aluminum Automotive Products
old_description: The Kobe Steel Group (KOBELCO) established operations as Kobelco Aluminum Automotive Products (KAAP) in Bowling Green, Kentucky, in 2005.  Since then, KAAP has undergone six facility expansions, adding equipment and expertise necessary to become a leader in forged aluminum suspension products.  Over time, KAAP established itself as a global leader in forged aluminum technology for the automotive industry.
about:
Kobelco Aluminum Automotive Products (KAAP) was established in 2005 in Bowling Green, Kentucky, as the U.S. operating arm of the Kobe Steel Group, known globally under the KOBELCO brand. The Japanese parent company, founded in 1937, entered the Kentucky community nearly two decades ago and has since invested in six facility expansions to build out forging capacity.

The plant specializes in aluminum forgings for automotive suspension components and cast rods for compressor applications, serving global automakers and tier-one suppliers. KAAP combines advanced engineering with high-volume forging and casting processes, though specific headcount, floor space, or annual part numbers are not publicly disclosed.

Its customer base centers on the automotive industry, with documented quality awards from Honda (Excellence in Quality), Nissan (Quality and Zero Defect), and Subaru (Excellent Performance). The company also supplies cast rods for compressor manufacturers, extending its reach beyond vehicle chassis into thermal-management systems.

KAAP cites its guiding principle, "Sei shin sei i" — put your heart and soul into your work — as the cultural foundation for its safety and environmental programs. The company emphasizes that its lightweight aluminum components reduce vehicle mass, lower fuel consumption, and cut carbon emissions, aligning product performance with sustainability goals.

name: Kokusai, Inc.
old_description: Custom manufacturer of production and laboratory testing equipment
about:
Kokusai, Inc. was founded in 1969 by Shigeru Matsumoto and is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with its global head office in Tokyo, Japan. The company employs over 300 people worldwide and reports annual sales of approximately $120 million.

The company designs and builds custom production and laboratory testing equipment for the automotive and tire industries. Its product line includes dynamic tire balancing machines, tire and tire/wheel uniformity testers, bead seating systems, wheel gauge uniformity and balancing equipment, precision balancers, shaft straightening machines, compression testers, coil winding testers, vibration and impact testers, servo motor controlled specialized testers, and torsion and tensile testers.

Kokusai serves automotive Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers as well as tire manufacturers, providing equipment that meets exacting demands for tire uniformity and quality. The company's machines are used for testing tire and wheel assemblies, force components, and small components across the automotive supply chain.

Since its founding, Kokusai has aimed to revolutionize the worldwide industrial market by being driven by technology, dedicated to precision, and committed to exceeding critical demands, positioning every product as the pinnacle of performance.

name: L & L Metal Fabrication Inc
old_description: We can provide a limitless range of custom fabrication options for metal products and equipment. We can produce everything from the most simple to elaborate, small or expansive. With our 30+ year experience, we have the capabilities, know-how and ability to take on projects and deliver solutions beyond our client’s expectations in a range of industries.
about:
L & L Metal Fabrication operates from a 34,000-square-foot facility in Tontitown, Arkansas. Founded more than 30 years ago, the company has grown into a full-service metal fabricator serving a broad range of industries. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication from cutting and forming through finishing and installation. Capabilities include laser cutting, high-definition CNC plasma cutting (tolerances to ±0.005 inch), dual-head waterjet cutting, four press brakes with CNC back gauges (forming up to 1/2-inch thick, 146-inch long parts), machining, welding, grinding (vibratory, tumbling, polishing), punching, stamping, roll forming, shearing, and saw cutting. The company also offers millwright services for equipment relocation and installation. Typical products range from bins, blower housings, and cabinets to conveyor systems, food-grade stainless equipment, exhaust hoods, machine guards, platforms, and ornamental pieces.

L & L serves customers in food processing, industrial manufacturing, construction, and architectural metalwork, among other sectors. Its design-build approach aims to streamline the path from concept to installed equipment.

The company emphasizes its bonded status, adherence to local and international safety certifications, modern computer-integrated equipment, competitive pricing, and a track record of repeat business.

old_description: L.A. Fabrication is a custom job shop that has been providing metal fabrication and welding services in Louisiana for more than 15 years. Our skilled artisans specialize in aluminum welding. You can also depend on us for fabrication projects involving materials such as carbon/mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.
about:
L.A. Fabrication, LLC is a custom job shop based in Kenner, Louisiana, that has been providing metal fabrication and welding services for more than 15 years. The company specializes in aluminum welding and also works with carbon/mild steel, stainless steel, and high-strength steel.

The shop offers a range of fabrication processes including CNC plasma cutting, laser cutting, TIG, MIG, and stick welding, shearing, bending, machining, and assembly. It can produce precision parts up to 6 feet by 12 feet with thicknesses up to 1 inch, holding a finished-part accuracy of ±0.004 inch and positioning repeatability of ±0.002 inch. Secondary services such as galvanizing, powder coating, heat treatment, and industrial painting are also available. The company handles projects from prototype through full production runs.

Its customer base includes municipal governments such as the cities of Baton Rouge, Kenner, and New Orleans; performing-arts venues like the Mahalia Jackson Theater, Saenger Theatre, and New Orleans Opera Association Scenic Studio; dental laboratories including National Dentex Labs; construction and development firms such as Lake Development and Legacy Development of Louisiana; fire-protection and flood-control contractors; and electrical and specialty manufacturers like Ducote Electric and Outlaw Grips.

L.A. Fabrication emphasizes its skilled artisans’ specialization in aluminum welding, in-house CAD/CAM design and CNC machinery, and a quality-control system aimed at delivering high-precision parts on time. The company states that its undivided attention to customer requirements sets it apart.
